name: SP-12 smoked-out halftime
desc: Halftime SP-12 groove led by dubbed-out 707 rimshots walking a rotating euclid: snare only on beat three, pitched-down dragging hats, everything soaked in slapback. Sparser and moodier than the .01 head-nodder.

code.full: stack(s("bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("EmuSP12").gain(${gain}).shape(.35), s("~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~").bank("EmuSP12").gain(${gain}*.82).room(${room}), s("rim(5,8,<0 2 4 6>)").bank("RolandTR707").gain(.3).delay(.3).delaytime(.375).delayfeedback(.35).pan(cosine.range(.35,.65).slow(21)), s("[hh@2 hh]*2").bank("EmuSP12").gain("[.42 .22 .3]*2").speed(.9).lpf(cosine.range(1600, ${cut}).slow(32))).fast(${rate}).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("bd ~ [~ bd] bd ~ ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("EmuSP12").gain(${gain}).shape(.4).every(8, x=>x.rev), s("~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ <~ [~ sd]>").bank("EmuSP12").gain(${gain}*.85).room(${room}), s("rim(7,8,<0 2 4 6>)").bank("RolandTR707").gain(.32).delay(.35).delaytime(.375).delayfeedback(.35), s("[hh@2 hh]*4").bank("EmuSP12").gain("[.5 .26 .36]*4").speed(.92).lpf(${cut}), s("~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ oh").bank("EmuSP12").gain(.4).mask("<1 1 0 1>")).fast(${rate}).orbit(1).play()
